items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: If Willie Pajot or somebody gonna take the trumpet solo, he knew it before he'd come because that's the way they played it, see?

ctx.x: They jazzed them up. They jazzed them up.

It was wonderful to hear them. I mean, and I mean, everything was rough. I mean, without telling the guy, he knew who was supposed to take the solo. You understand? If Willie Pajot or somebody gonna take the trumpet solo, he knew it before he'd come because that's the way they played it, see?
That was one of Pajot's biggest fusses with the Eureka band to make them rehearse.
